subject: A5-SFV2-ARM2-SMA200-WEEKLY turnover feasibility ceiling (W1 freeze open item)
binding_interpretation: The preregistered A5 turnover feasibility ceiling '6.0x two-way per year' (selection_freeze.json a7_objective_O1_fix; w1_freeze.json costs) binds on the S0-span average-annualized two-way turnover of the arm schedule. A5-SFV2-ARM2-SMA200-WEEKLY measures 5.4545x/yr (47.1749 two-way total over the frozen coverage span 2018-01-02..2026-08-27, independently recomputed by this audit) and is WITHIN the ceiling: ARM2 is ELIGIBLE and the A5 three-cell Stage-A design stands (anchor, neighbour, causal control).

fold_level_advisories.note: Fold-level annualized spikes are recorded as advisories with their cost-drag consequence quantified; they are inputs to the after-cost Stage-A gates (PLAN section 14), not an independent per-fold ceiling.
fold_level_advisories.quantification_note: The W1 referral quoted '~80-160bps drag' for fold-3; that understates because 8.05x is an ANNUALIZED rate. Correct cumulative fold-3 drag is ~195 bps at the 10 bps/side base cost and ~389 bps at the 20 bps/side stress cost (roughly 0.8-1.6%/yr in-fold drag). These are exactly the cost facts the after-cost Stage-A gates (expectancy>0, stressed PnL>0 and PF>=1.00) will price in; if ARM2 fails those gates it fails on its own terms.

stage_a_application: PLAN section 14 gate 'turnover/capacity remain feasible' for family A5 is evaluated against this binding average-annual reading (5.45x/yr <= 6.0x/yr: feasible), with the fold advisories above attached to the A5 cell artifacts.
justification_from_frozen_texts: 1. selection_freeze.json a7_objective_O1_fix: 'A5_turnover_feasibility_ceiling': '6.0x two-way per year (schedule-only, measured at Z6; matches declared neighbour upper bound)'. The ceiling is definitionally anchored to the neighbour's declared upper bound, which is a5_arm2_sma200_weekly.json turnover_expectation.expected_two_way_annual = '3.0x - 6.0x' - a field explicitly named ANNUAL and declared as an expectation 'from rule structure (MODEL_INTERNAL_UNVERIFIED)'. A per-fold-annualized ceiling appears in no frozen text.

2. Purpose: PLAN section 11 lists 'schedule-only turnover/cost feasibility' as a W1 feasibility check and PLAN section 14 asks 'turnover/capacity remain feasible'. Feasibility is a property of the arm's tradeable turnover RATE at declared costs, naturally measured as the S0-span annualized average. S0 folds are statistical scoring replicates with purge-truncated unequal windows, not calendar years; the preregistered text says 'per year', not 'per fold'.

3. Anti-post-hoc: adopting the per-fold reading now, after the Z6 schedule measurement, would retroactively tighten a preregistered annual-rate bound into a per-fold bound - a post-hoc degree of freedom no frozen text authorizes - and would destroy a preregistered trial identity (and with it the A5 'neighbour supports the anchor' gate, PLAN section 14) on a cost-property technicality rather than on evidence of infeasibility. Option A preserves the preregistration's exact preregistered meaning. Neither reading uses any return data (nothing is scored; budget 0/6).

4. Consistency: the W1 freeze records the average-annual figure as the headline within-ceiling measurement and refers only the fold spikes for adjudication; PLAN section 10 keeps blocked slots unused only for BLOCKED families - with Option A, A5 is not blocked.
consequence: A5 proceeds with all three cells (ARM1 anchor, ARM2 neighbour, ARM3 causal control). Fold advisories travel with the A5 Z8 artifacts. No frozen field is modified by this adjudication.
